//better-sqlite3: dependencies.better-sqlite3 is pinned exact (no caret): WiseLibs stopped publishing a Node 20 prebuild (node-v115) as of 12.10.0 (Node 20 hit EOL in April 2026); 13.x requires Node >=22 outright and has no per-ABI prebuild at all. A caret here would let a future install silently drift into a version with no working prebuild and no compiler to fall back on -- bump only after checking the target Node has a published prebuild at https://github.com/WiseLibs/better-sqlite3/releases.
